_comment: Shipped template. The installer replaces every {{...}} placeholder: {{USER_GMAIL}} = the Gmail address this bridge reads tasks from and sends results with; {{GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD}} = that account's 16-char Google app password (myaccount.google.com/apppasswords). A blank device_tag means this computer's name. Device entries are ignored until the installer replaces their {{..._ID}} key with a real device ID (D followed by two or more digits); an IP left as a placeholder is treated as unset. The bridge ignores unknown keys such as this one.
